scope: Private snapshot handoff construction and ownership integrity repair. No protocol, default, public root, Rust or native-runtime change. This is selected functional qualification, not whole-room adoption, full candidate qualification or V1 approval.

includes: All four normal main manifests, 17 complete stage logs and their artifacts
Both independent frozen full SDK normal manifests, logs and complete reports
Fresh actual source, installed-consumer and production-bundle results
Three matching actual package archives and installed assertion/fixture sources
Byte-identical portable before/after assertions and real failing/passing controls
Original failed orphan SDK envelopes and the separate closed-stderr control
All 5305 common input hashes, normal runtime bytes and actual distribution diff
Five changed source/test inputs and the previous V3 retention index

reproduction.cause: The old witness released actual upload custody before constructing returned wrappers. A throwing construction boundary rejected the handoff after ownership had already been consumed; construction could also expose unreturned owners.
reproduction.repair: Construct guarded closed wrappers before the last policy/native check, then synchronously release custody and open the returned wrappers. No wrapper construction, permission callback or await follows the final comparison.

failureAccounting.closedStderrControl: An actual EPIPE follows the completed source read when its Git stderr reader is removed; draining that reader exits zero. This is consistent with the orphan failures, not a reconstruction of their lost error tails.

remaining: Complete retained-copy, provider and client reconciliation
Sustainable native Undo and offline retention beyond current ceilings
Remaining full feature parity and all thirteen V1 gates
